lastCompletedStory.title: Auto-invoke the archive check on the --cycle-close path

nextStoryContext: dispatchJournal's --cycle-close success path now auto-invokes the archive check: order is (1) CAM_JOURNAL_APPENDED write, (2) recordCycleTokensFn, (3) handoffExistsFn guard (exit 3 on absent), (4) watcherAliveFn guard (exit 4 on dead), (5) the NEW archive check (best-effort: deps.archiveFn ?? defaultArchiveFn, called with JOURNAL_ARCHIVE_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, wrapped in try/catch, ok:false or throw -> printWarning + continue, never changes the return code), (6) armMarker(), (7) CAM_ORCH_HANDOFF_DUE=true. defaultArchiveFn (module-level in index.ts) is the shared production fallback for BOTH the explicit 'archive' mode dispatch and this new auto-invoked call -- one dep (archiveFn on JournalDispatchDeps), two call sites. Plain 'cam journal append' (no --cycle-close) never reaches this code, verified by a dedicated test. IMPORTANT gotcha for any future dispatchJournal test that sets handoffExistsFn:()=>true AND watcherAliveFn:()=>true: it now reaches the archive-check call site, so it MUST inject archiveFn explicitly (e.g. ({ ok: true, archived: 0, entries: 0, sha: '' })) or the test falls through to defaultArchiveFn and hits REAL git (network fetch + possibly a real commit to main) -- this bit two pre-existing US-002-era tests in this story and both were fixed. US-004 (replace the manual archive rule in templates and agent file) is next: edit templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (~line 294) AND .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (~line 294, dual copy is per-file, diff both before editing per the cam-dual-copy-is-per-file pattern) to replace the 'propose to the human ... do not do this autonomously' manual-archive rule with the deterministic 'cam journal archive' behavior (auto-run at cycle close via US-003, manual run allowed, no summarization). Also edit templates/scripts/cam/journal.md (~line 41) guideline bullet the same way. Do NOT touch the live scripts/cam/journal.md on this branch (it is mutated on main by commit-tree during live cycles; an AC oracle explicitly checks the branch diff is empty for that path). After editing templates/, run bun run embed-vendor then bun run embed-vendor:check (src/vendor/_generated.ts must regenerate clean). Agent instruction files (.claude/agents/*.md, templates/agents/*.md) are LLM-consumed and exempt from the no-em-dash-in-persisted-markdown house rule; templates/scripts/cam/journal.md is human-readable persisted markdown so avoid em-dash in any NEW text there.
